summary: Inspected books/kestrel/number-theory/tonelli-shanks-proof.lisp (54KB, 1328 lines). This file contains the complete formal proof of correctness for the Tonelli-Shanks modular square root algorithm in ACL2. It includes numerous theorems (defthm/defthmd), encapsulate blocks with local lemmas, and mathematical proofs covering: properties of y^2 ≡ 1 (mod p), least-repeated-square invariants, loop invariants of the algorithm (t-s-aux-invariant1/2/3), base case (t-s-aux-base-case), equivalence theorem (t-s-aux-equiv), and the final correctness theorems (tonelli-shanks-sqrt-aux-is-sqrt-modp, tonelli-shanks-sqrt-aux-is-correct, tonelli-shanks-is-sqrt-modp, tonelli-shanks-is-correct). This is authored formal verification content — a machine-checked proof of a number-theoretic algorithm — not a build artifact, certification wrapper, or import-only module.

harness.lisp: Defines load-vector, check-vector, run-vector, classify-mismatches, run-vectors-aux, run-vectors, vector-record, report-records, summarize-vectors with defthm mismatch-listp-of-check-vector, mismatch-alistp-of-mv-nth-0-of-run-vectors, load-vector-of-update-nth (proving state independence)

report.lisp: Defines waiver-applies-p, find-waiver, apply-waivers, classify-record, summarize-record, summarize-records, summarize-results, merge-summaries with defthm count-alistp-of-add-count, by-name-alistp-of-add-name-counts, summaryp-of-merge-summaries
smoke.lisp: Defines *smoke-vectors*, *unknown-vectors*, *ge-vectors*, *class-vectors* constants with assert-event checks verifying (check-summary summary) and exact mismatch/unknown/waiver counts
vectors.lisp: Defines test-vectorp, expectp, vec-get, reg-alistp, mem-triple-listp, default-sctlr.u with formal recognizers used by harness
